summary: This document outlines the architectural plan and slice-based implementation for 'clankerlog integrations' CLI commands to automate agent hook configuration.
responsibilities: Define design constraints for managing external agent configuration files (Codex/Claude).
Specify safety requirements: idempotence, atomic writes, dry-run support, and preservation of user data.
Outline the multi-slice development path from pure logic to filesystem integration and command registration.
Establish the command surface (install, status, uninstall) for managing agent Stop hooks.
